method.candidate_scope: All12 recipes in fixed12:58 failed-candidate audit, no subset/selection
method.alphas: Use audited alpha float exactly; no reoptimization in original data or bootstrap
method.calendar: KST right-closed hourly interval date = ts minus1hour; calendar month and Monday-start week
method.weather_scope: Daylight rows; all-night rows reported separately and retained in full metrics
method.bootstrap: Paired complete Monday-Sunday calendar weeks sampled jointly across both groups, with replacement, same draws across all12recipes; partial edge weeks held fixed in every draw
method.inference: Percentile95% conditional descriptive intervals, not independent test inference or selection-adjusted coverage

limitations: All12 recipes were identified after an exposed2048-configuration search; these intervals do not adjust for candidate selection, multiple comparisons, or the data-dependent primary alpha.
Alphas are frozen from the earlier audit in every resample. Primary estimates are partly optimized on the evaluated primary outcomes and are optimistic as future-performance evidence.
The five original development folds overlap and cannot be treated as independent replications. This analysis reports primary/recent separately and does not pool a fivefold confidence interval.

Complete-week resampling preserves within-week dependence and covariance between the two groups, but does not account for dependence spanning multiple weeks or future distribution changes. Partial edge weeks are held fixed, conditioning away their uncertainty.
Monthly and weather slices are descriptive, with no multiplicity-adjusted tests; small or missing bins must not be used to choose coefficients or models.
Failed summaries remain uncommitted and omitted from finalization. This audit does not repair, promote, refit, seed-validate, deploy, upload, or select these recipes.
No March-May2025 late-audit target values were read; the search boundary is2025-03-01 00:00KST inclusive.
Local error changes and proxy revenue effects are not official leaderboard improvements; no independent test or new official score is claimed.
